rejected_candidates.failure_scope: first guarded scratch child before publication

observations: One attempt completed three guarded scratch children but its parent comparator environment lacked the CPU safetensors package, so it earned no parity credit.
The corrected attempt completed the first two guarded children and then the independent replay breached the live-memory reserve before publication.

claim_boundary: This selects a repeatable segment length for this M1 host and current exact implementation. It is not a general 32-step optimum, a cross-host limit, or evidence that longer segments cannot fit after a materially different memory implementation.
